Concerns noted at that meeting were similar to those received through correspondence.
Information was provided in response to the concerns that the proposal does comply with the regulations of the zoning by law.
It accommodates an expansion of an existing operation and has been reviewed by other civic departments such as transportation and the fire department who did not identify any concerns.
Now there are currently three other discretionary uses approved in the Montgomery place neighborhood and those are noted in appendix three of your report.
